# BuildAWallet
Free HUMAN wallet design and implementation plan; paid read-only Base and Solana mainnet API data.
API plans and wallet payment: https://buildawallet.xyz/pay
OpenAPI: https://buildawallet.xyz/machine/openapi.json
MCP (API key required for calls): https://buildawallet.xyz/mcp
x402 pay per request: https://buildawallet.xyz/machine/info
Service capabilities: https://buildawallet.xyz/.well-known/agent.json
No custody, key management, signing or transaction submission.
